title: The Computational Assessment Stack: An Architecture for AI-Native Measurement
abstract: arXiv:2610.33901v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Test development is shifting toward automation and agentic artificial intelligence (AI), in which autonomous systems draft items at scale, assemble test forms, administer adaptive assessments, score complex responses, and monitor test quality. As autonomous systems take on more of this work, the architecture underlying test development must change to preserve assessment quality under the new paradigm. This paper proposes the Computational Assessment Stack (CAS), a four-layer architecture for AI-native measurement where every stage of the assessment lifecycle shares a unifying computational construct representation as its base layer. This representation is a machine-readable, modular, and versioned knowledge graph. translated_title: 计算化评估堆栈：一种面向AI原生测量的架构
translated_abstract: 测试开发正在向自动化和智能体人工智能转变，在这一范式下，自主系统能够大规模起草试题、组装试卷、实施自适应测评、对复杂作答进行评分并监控测试质量。随着自主系统承担更多此类工作，测试开发的基础架构必须随之改变，以便在新范式下保持测评质量。本文提出了计算化评估堆栈（CAS），这是一种面向AI原生测量的四层架构，评估生命周期的每个阶段都共享一个统一的计算化构念表示作为其底层。该表示是一个机器可读、模块化且可版本管理的知识图谱。在其之上构建了三层：基于知识图谱的计算化内容生成层；直接从知识图谱推导实质结构的计算心理测量学层；以及一个编排层……
tldr: 本文提出计算化评估堆栈（CAS），一种以机器可读、模块化、可版本化的统一计算构念表示（知识图谱）为基础的四层AI原生测量架构，通过计算化内容生成、计算心理测量学与编排层，在智能体AI主导测试开发的新范式下保障测评质量。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Computational Assessment Stack (CAS), a four-layer architecture for AI-native measurement built on a unified machine-readable, modular, and versioned knowledge-graph construct representation, enabling computational content generation, computational psychometrics, and orchestration to preserve assessment quality under agentic AI-driven test development.
